title: eng-releases
text:
eng-releases

deploy-bot: Deploy started: tag `v1.2.7-hotfix-20260319` -> production. commit `ab12cd34`. Initiated by @alice. Targets: web-api, dedupe-service. Canary plan: 5% for 5m then ramp. Change window: emergency hotfix for token truncation bug. Rollout plan: canary -> ramp -> promote. https://ci.internal/release/17725 :shipit:
alice: Rolling now. I'll watch errors and p95. Ping me if anything spikes.
carla_sre: Monitoring dashboards. I set alerts for 5xx and p95. Will post updates here.
bob: Quick heads-up — dedupe-service branch `feature/remove-legacy` not in this tag, confirmed. No DB migrations.
danny: We pinned image `redwood/dedupe:v1.2.7-hotfix` in the helm release. Command used: `helm upgrade --install dedupe ./charts/dedupe --set image.tag=v1.2.7-hotfix`
deploy-bot: Canary progress: 5% -> 25% ramp completed. No global errors in first 3m.
carla_sre: Seeing a spike of 502s from edge-1 at +2m after canary. Investigating. Stack traces point to `kvcache` NPE in dedupe.
alice: Hold the ramp. Do not promote further. Can we rollback dedupe only?
danny: Yes — we can do a partial rollback by pinning dedupe back to `v1.2.6` while leaving web-api on `v1.2.7-hotfix`. I'll prepare a patch to helm values.
lucy: We're inside the emergency change window, go ahead with partial rollback. I'll notify support and update the incident doc.
deploy-bot: Action: partial rollback initiated for `dedupe-service` -> `v1.2.6` (commit `d4e5f6a7`). Estimated completion ~2m.
carla_sre: Confirming error rates dropping; 502s falling toward baseline. p95 latency stable again. I'll keep monitors for 10m.
alice: Leaving web-api on the hotfix tag. Filing an action item to fix `kvcache` NPE in next patch. Issue: #4521.
bob: :thumbsup: Add note to release notes: "hotfix partially rolled back for dedupe due to kvcache NPE; other fixes deployed to web-api."
deploy-bot: Deploy finished: partial success. web-api: `v1.2.7-hotfix` promoted. dedupe-service: rolled back to `v1.2.6`. Release notes: https://redwood/internal/releases/v1.2.7-hotfix. Ops tag: @prod-ops. Thread closed.
